info.label: Make to-dos with AI
info.title: Talk, and AI splits it into to-dos
info.description: Tap the mic and say what you want to do. Dates, times, and repeats are filled in for you.
info.examples: It understands "every day," "Mon Wed Fri," "all next week," and "just for me."
info.notCharged: If it fails, it doesn't count

quickStart.title: You can just say it now
quickStart.description: Say everything on your mind. AI fills in dates, times, and repeats for you.

listening.pausedHint: Paused for a moment. Keep listening?
listening.autoFinishHint: We'll wrap up when you pause

failed.keptText: We kept what we heard. Keep talking or fix it yourself.
